description:

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

A Network Operations Center (NOC) Manager is responsible for ensuring the efficient and effective operations of a customer network infrastructure.

They oversee the team responsible for monitoring the customer network and troubleshoot any issues that arise.

• Manage the day-to-day operations of the NOC team.

• Identify, diagnose, and resolve network issues.

• Collaborate with other departments and the customer to address network-related problems.

• Ensure that the network is highly available and meets requirements.

• Proactively monitor network performance and capacity, and plan for growth as needed.

• Develop and maintain NOC policies and procedures.

• Coach and mentor NOC staff on technical issues and professional development.

What We Look For in a Candidate

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology or a related field.

• Five or more years' experience in network operations center management.

• Strong technical knowledge of networking, security, and infrastructure technologies.

• Expertise in network monitoring tools and techniques.

• Excellent communication and team management skills.

• Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.

• Requires Public Trust suitability

title: Machine Learning Engineer III (Applied Research & Model Development)
description:
PathAI 's mission is to improve patient outcomes with AI-powered pathology. Our platform promises substantial improvements to the accuracy of diagnosis and the efficacy of treatment of diseases like cancer, leveraging modern approaches in machine learning and artificial intelligence. We have a track record of success in deploying AI algorithms for histopathology in translational research, pathology labs and clinical trials. Rigorous science and careful analysis is critical to the success of everything we do. Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems and making a huge impact on patient outcomes.
The Opportunity
We are seeking Machine Learning Engineers (Applied Research & Model Development) to tackle unique machine learning challenges to advance medicine and improve patient care. You will work closely with teams across biomedical data science, product development, translational research, MLOps, and platform engineering to develop and deploy machine learning models for our AI products and services.
You will have the opportunity to work in a company where all employees put patients first. We believe that every team member provides valuable contributions to our success, and no task is too small for anyone if it's important to our company goals. Every PathAI employee is a contributor to our mission to pioneer better patient care by providing the best, most innovative AI tools to biotech, pathologists, clinicians and healthcare organizations. You will work alongside and with leading innovators in the field of AI and medicine and you will play a critical role in product development to impact patient outcomes.

• You will design, develop, and deploy machine learning models for research and product development projects.

• You will collaborate cross-functionally with scientists, engineers, and product teams to translate biological and clinical requirements into scalable ML solutions.

• You will contribute to experimental design and analysis, including ideation, documentation, and reporting.

• You will participate in knowledge sharing and team initiatives (e.g., design reviews, journal clubs, ML best practices, governance activities).

• You will improve ML pipelines and infrastructure in partnership with MLOps and platform teams.

• You will publish and present scientific work, supporting abstracts, manuscripts, and conference contributions.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a Master’s degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics (or a closely related discipline) with 5 or more years of experience; or a PhD Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics (or a closely related discipline) with 3 or more years of experience.

• You have a proven track record of developing and deploying machine learning models into production or research applications.

• You are highly proficient in Python, ML frameworks, and data pipeline development.

• You have demonstrated the ability to work independently, lead/contribute to experimental design, and improve ML workflows.

• You have demonstrated the ability to collaborate across scientific and engineering teams.

Preferred:

• You have strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-experts and thrive in ambiguous environments.

• You have excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects efficiently.

This position is based in Boston, NYC or remote.
Relocation benefits are not available for this position.
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location Boston, MA is $130,500 - $200,100. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

That’s why our business expertise, focus on relationships, and market-leading technology is at the core of everything we do. title: Director, Quantitative Systems Pharmacology
description:
At Eisai , satisfying unmet medical needs and increasing the benefits healthcare provides to patients, their families, and caregivers is Eisai ’s human health care (hhc) mission. We’re a growing pharmaceutical company that is breaking through in neurology and oncology, with a strong emphasis on research and development. Our history includes the development of many innovative medicines, notably the discovery of the world's most widely-used treatment for Alzheimer’s disease. As we continue to expand, we are seeking highly-motivated individuals who want to work in a fast-paced environment and make a difference.If this is your profile, we want to hear from you.
The Director of Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) will lead the development and implementation of mechanistic knowledge of biology integrated into mathematical models that support drug discovery and clinical development. The Director of QSP will provide scientific leadership, define QSP strategies, and collaborate across Eisai ’s Deep Human Biology Learning (DHBL) project teams to translate existing knowledge and data into actionable QSP models. These models will provide functional understanding of complex nonlinear pathophysiological systems and their interactions, will allow scientists to explore system dynamics and biological hypotheses, will yield insight into responses to different pharmacological approaches to modulating biological systems, and will provide mechanistic insights to inform Eisai ’s R&D decisions (for example FIH translation, dose selection, candidate selection, selection of target population, and combination strategies). This Director QSP position is essential for supporting the increasing expectations of team leaders and global regulators of applying QSP methodologies to continuously improve the conceptual and mechanistic understanding of the relations among drug exposure, efficacy, and safety. Essential Functions:

• Develop, implement, and apply QSP models to understand diseases, their pathways, and their progressions. Evaluate DHBL drug candidates and treatment modalities to predict their effects and optimize therapeutic strategies (e.g., the selection of target tumor types and populations), and to support clinical introduction including first-in-human dose selection.

• Use and improve existing Neurology QSP Platforms to gain insights into the causal relationships between biological and drug-level responses, enhancing the understanding of drug-target interactions and disease mechanisms. Develop new QSP models and platforms as they are needed.

• Lead DHBL preclinical and early clinical QSP development strategy to support optimal dose selection with simulations based on mechanistic understanding to assess efficacy and safety.

• Advocate for model-informed drug discovery and development (MIDD) approaches. Provide scientific leadership, present research at scientific conferences, and integrate MIDD strategies into Eisai ’s R&D programs to improve efficiency and decision-making.

• Foster collaboration across functional groups and promote the development of new modeling tools and methods. Advance the adoption of QSP capabilities to improve the predictive power of these tools to support the design and optimization of drug combinations.

• Manage the expectations/timelines of assigned M&S work for the relevant project teams.

• Use mathematical, computational, and statistical tools to analyze and interpret large, complex data sets to gain insights into the causal relationships between drug-target interactions and disease mechanisms.

• Provide scientific/strategic expertise across multiple therapeutic areas to support decision-making in the conversion of discovery to clinical through the design, development, and execution of quantitative mechanistic models to support the translational process.

Requirements:

• PhD, MD-PhD and/or PharmD in Bioengineering, Systems Biology, Applied Mathematics, Computational Biology, Pharmacometrics, Chemical Engine

Platform & Developer Enablement

You will be the face of Statista Connect in front of customers: pitching the solution, building and demoing custom agents live, and turning technical capability into a compelling story that wins hearts and budgets. This is a hybrid role where technical expertise meets showmanship. If you light up when you get to demo something you built and watch a customer's eyes widen - this role is for you. If presenting to customers feels like a chore you'd rather delegate, it is not.

- Pitching & Demoing (core of the role): Deliver compelling pitches and live demos of Statista Connect to prospects and customers, from analysts to C-level. - Commercial Support: Identify upsell and expansion opportunities and support sales teams with demos and technical storytelling in renewal and growth conversations.

- Feedback Loop: Share insights from pitches, demos, and usage data with product and engineering to sharpen the pitch, refine demo agents, and shape the roadmap.

What We're Looking For

- A Genuine Love of Pitching: Presenting energizes you rather than drains you - you've delivered demos or pitches before and seek out more. (If this doesn't describe you, this role won't be a good fit - and that's okay.)

- Builder & Storyteller: You prototype agents, workflows, and prompts yourself, hands-on, and know how to turn technical capability into a business value narrative with maximum "wow."

Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) is hiring a Senior Pre-Sales Systems Engineer to support our Higher Education business, with a focus on R1 research universities.

R1 institutions are not one customer. A single campus can behave like a dozen different organizations at the same time: central IT running enterprise applications, research computing and HPC teams, genomics and imaging cores, AI and machine learning labs competing for GPU time, an academic medical center with its own rules and its own budget, and faculty groups buying infrastructure directly with grant money. Decisions move through CIOs, research computing directors, principal investigators, sponsored programs offices, procurement, and consortium contract vehicles, often in parallel and not always in agreement.

That environment rewards someone who can hold a lot of context at once, translate between very different audiences, and connect technology to the outcomes these institutions actually care about: time to result for researchers, compliance with sponsor and grant requirements, data that stays usable for a decade or more, and budgets that have to stretch further every year.

You will be the technical lead on these accounts, working alongside account managers, specialists, and partners to build solutions customers can defend internally, both technically and financially.

Location: MD / VA

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Develop a real understanding of what drives each institution: research priorities, funding cycles, capital versus operating constraints, and who actually makes the decision

• Connect technology, including the Everpure portfolio and the broader ecosystem, to measurable research and institutional outcomes

• Move fluently between principal investigators, research computing staff, central IT, CIOs, finance, and procurement, adapting the conversation to each audience instead of delivering the same presentation

• Build the business case alongside the technical one: total cost of ownership, power and cooling, data center footprint, staff time, and the real cost of the current environment

• Support research workloads end to end, from instrument and sequencer output through HPC and AI pipelines to long-term retention and archive

• Help customers work through data management questions: lifecycle and retention, reproducibility, sponsor and funding agency data sharing expectations, research data governance, and security requirements such as NIST 800-171 and CMMC where they apply

• Partner closely with account managers, specialists, channel partners, and higher education purchasing consortia and contract vehicles

• Take ownership of evaluations, benchmarks, proofs of concept, and system configurations, and secure the technical win

• Capture requirements and translate them into solutions that help institutions grow their research capability rather than just their capacity

• Author responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, which in this segment are frequent and detailed

• Stay current on the competitive landscape and make sure our positioning reflects it honestly

• Follow market and research computing trends closely enough to bring that thinking back into our organization

• Lead by example living the Pure Values: Persistence, Creativity, Teamwork, Ownership and Customer-first

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required

• 8 or more years of relevant experience across technology, solution design, and customer-facing communication

Sr. Deployment Strategist, FDE - Public Sector

About the Team

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have

• C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

• End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

• Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

• Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

title: Hardware Systems Engineer
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Bengaluru

About the department

Cloudflare’s Infrastructure group is responsible for building our global network. Our Hardware Engineering team helps research, develop, test, and deploy new equipment enabling 20% of the world’s internet traffic to be served smoothly. Deployed across 330 cities in 120+ countries, the hardware we select helps improve the security, reliability, and performance of the Internet.

About the Role

We need to make thoughtful infrastructure choices affecting a significant portion of the Internet. Hardware we work with includes servers and components, as well as PDUs and network hardware. . As a Hardware Systems Engineer, you will work with colleagues on the Hardware Engineering, Product teams, and Hardware Sourcing teams to troubleshoot and maintain Cloudflare’s worldwide fleet of storage and compute servers.

What you'll do

Exp: 3-5yrs

• Work with software teams to validate bug fixes and assess performance of new firmware revisions

• Validate and deploy firmware updates to the fleet, monitoring the progress of the rollout for compliance and reliability

• Work with server and component vendors to obtain, debug, and maintain the latest updates

• Work with our Site Reliability Engineering teams to triage hardware problem reports

• Support our Data Centre Engineering teams in resolving hardware issues

• Develop and maintain automation tools to update firmware on servers and components in Cloudflare’s fleet

• Communicate your results and updates through blog posts, internal talks, and tickets

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science

• Desire to learn about the Cloudflare hardware used by 20% of all web sites

• Desire to learn how a diverse server fleet is managed at scale

• Desire to learn the tools Cloudflare uses to maintain and monitor our hardware

• Knowledge of bash and python and basic Linux task automation

• Knowledge of x86 server hardware including motherboards, CPUs, memory, storage and firmware updates. Knowledge of other platforms such as arm is a bonus.

• Knowledge of configuration management principals, in particular we use salt to manage our fleet

• Knowledge of Redfish, IPMI and server remote management protocols

• Knowledge of running production mission critical systems

Bonus Points

• Familiarity with server hardware architecture

Обов'язки:

• Перетворювати стратегію продуктової лінійки на конкретні беклоги команди та валідувати результати спринтів для забезпечення стабільного виконання.

• Володіти та постійно пріоритизувати беклог команди, щоб зусилля розробки фокусувалися на найцінніших завданнях, які відповідають цілям продукту.

• Визначати цілі спринтів, брати участь у плануванні спринтів та координувати роботу з командою для забезпечення реалістичних зобов'язань.

• Керувати змінами обсягу робіт та вхідними запитами під час спринтів, комунікувати зміни зі стейкхолдерами та відповідно коригувати плани спринтів.

• Забезпечувати, щоб доопрацювання беклогу командою узгоджувалося зі стратегією та пріоритетами продукту, валідуючи результати.

• Співпрацювати з Product Management та стейкхолдерами для вдосконалення функцій продукту на основі підтверджених ринкових та клієнтських інсайтів.

• Координувати роботу бізнес-аналітиків, системних аналітиків та інших ролей на етапі дослідження (discovery), забезпечуючи чіткість та технічну реалізованість вимог.

• Допомагати з наданням вимог команді, якщо мета та обсяг зрозумілі.

• Планувати релізи (на рівні команди) у співпраці з Engineering Manager (PO визначає обсяг → EM координує виконання).

• Брати участь у приймальному тестуванні функцій та демонстраціях для перевірки якості та повноти.

• Брати участь та співкерувати ретроспективами спринтів разом з EM, ініціюючи покращення командних практик.

• Керувати процесом виявлення ризиків та шляхами ескалації (PO визначає продуктові ризики → EM керує ризиками постачання).

• Виступати основним експертом (SME) для внутрішніх стейкхолдерів, надаючи необхідний контекст для якісних релізів.

• Валідувати проєктні плани та документацію для стейкхолдерів за потреби (у співпраці з DM).

• Встановлювати та підтримувати співпрацю з веб-департаментом та іншими командами, коли потрібна крос-продуктова робота.

• Координувати крос-командні епіки та забезпечувати узгодженість щодо спільного функціоналу.

• Працювати з інструментом Estimator, отримувати погодження та підтримувати процес оцінювання (EM оцінює → PO/DM погоджує).

• Співпрацювати з QA для класифікації проблем (інцидент чи покращення) та пріоритизувати баги в Product Backlog на основі впливу на бізнес.

Вимоги:

• 3+ роки досвіду на позиції Product Owner, Product Manager, Delivery Manager або на подібних ролях

• 2+ роки досвіду у сфері Pharma, Life Sciences або фармацевтичного маркетингу (в IT/tech середовищі) - процеси та системи ланцюга постачання контенту (створення контенту, MLR, CRM, Veeva, AEM, SFDC)

• Підтверджений успішний досвід визначення та запуску продуктів, що відповідають бізнес-цілям

• Досвід роботи з продуктами на основі AI/ML, включно з розумінням життєвого циклу моделей, метрик оцінювання та обмежень, таких як упередженість (bias) та галюцинації

• Впевнене володіння Jira, Confluence та методологіями Agile/Scrum

• Досвід написання user stories, критеріїв приймання (acceptance criteria) та технічних специфікацій

• Знання технік оцінювання (story points, T-shirt sizing)

• Рівень англійської мови - Upper-Intermediate або вище

Що ми пропонуємо?
Команда має для нас велике значення, тому ми цінуємо її та надаємо можливість кожному ділитися своїм бачен

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

title: 2D Moho Animator - Human Buddy
description:
We’re looking for a 2D animator who knows Moho well and loves turning scripts and storyboards into entertaining, polished animation.

You’ll work on Human Buddy , one of Telos Media ’s brands, an animated medicine show where the Doctor and a cast of sentient living organs explore the human body, medicine and health through comedy, storytelling and animation.

What you’ll be obsessed about

Making every scene work.

You care about timing, acting, expressions, movement and all the small details that make 2D animation feel alive.

You don’t just make characters move from A to B. You think about what the character is doing, why they’re doing it and how the animation supports the joke, explanation or story.

You should be the kind of person who watches a scene and thinks:

“This could land better. I know what I’d change.”

What you’ll do

• Animate Human Buddy episodes in Moho, working from approved scripts and storyboards

• Animate characters, props, backgrounds, transitions and other visual elements

• Create and work with character rigs in Moho

• Turn storyboards into polished animation while keeping the timing, acting and visual storytelling clear

• Match the established Human Buddy visual style and keep your scenes consistent with the rest of the episode

• Work closely with the Creative Director and other animators to maintain consistency across the episode

• Take feedback and make revisions quickly

• Flag problems early and figure out practical solutions rather than waiting for someone else to catch them

• Keep your scenes organised and deliver them according to the agreed production schedule

• Use motion graphics when needed to support explanations, transitions, jokes and other visual elements

• Look for ways to make the animation more efficient without compromising the quality of the final video

What we’re looking for

• Professional experience as a 2D animator

• Strong Moho experience. You should be very comfortable working in Moho without needing step-by-step instructions

• Hands-on experience with character rigging in Moho

• Strong understanding of 2D animation principles, including timing, spacing, posing and character acting

• Experience working from scripts and storyboards

• Good visual storytelling instincts. You understand how animation can make a scene clearer, funnier or more engaging

• Able to work within an established visual style rather than needing to define the entire style yourself

• Very organised and able to manage your own scenes and deadlines

• Comfortable collaborating with other animators and taking direction from a Creative Director

• Good at taking feedback and turning it into concrete changes

• Proactive. If you see something that could be better, you say so and ideally fix it

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving production environment

Bonus points

• Strong motion graphics skills

• Experience animating for YouTube or other digital-first content

• Experience working on comedy, educational or explainer animation

• Experience working with a distributed animation team

• You’re a Human Buddy, SolarBalls, MrSpherical or Telos Media fan

Hours

Part-time, with flexible working hours and regular overlap with the South America-based team.

You’ll need enough overlap with the team to collaborate, receive feedback and keep production moving, but we’re flexible about your exact working hours.

The Applied AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Manager of Applied AI Architects, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for OpenAI's largest and most complex customers. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.

You will set the operating model for how Applied AI Architects own technical account plans across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with Sales leadership and Account Directors, you will help prioritize customer portfolios, allocate technical resources, and ensure business priorities translate into focused use cases, credible architectures, actionable adoption roadmaps, and durable customer value and growth.

You will remain accountable for the team's technical outcomes while developing its people and bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, research, and partners. You will serve as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements, a senior voice of the customer inside OpenAI, and a cross-functional leader who can move confidently between regional strategy, executive decision-making, architectural depth, and hands-on coaching.

This role is based in Bangalore.

- Partner with Sales leadership and Account Directors to prioritize accounts and opportunities, allocate technical resources effectively, and establish clear technical strategies for the region's most consequential engagements.

- Ensure Applied AI Architects serve as the primary technical advisors for their portfolios, owning technical account plans, technical milestones, adoption priorities, account health, and expansion opportunities.

- Lead complex, multi-threaded customer journeys that connect executive vision and business outcomes with use-case qualification, solution evaluation, enterprise governance, and a credible path to production.

- Coach the team on Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment.

- Build trusted relationships with C-suite and board-level stakeholders, as well as senior AI, technology, data, security, and engineering leaders, serving as an executive technical sponsor when needed.

- Mobilize Deployment Engineering, implementation, enablement, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Legal, Privacy, partners, and other specialists to remove blockers and deliver a cohesive customer experience.

- Establish a rigorous view of portfolio health, including technical wins, qualified use cases, production readiness, adoption, usage, risks, measurable customer impact, and the technical contribution to growth.

- Translate patterns from the field into actionable feedback for Product,

title: Teamleiter Immobilienverwaltung (m/w/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich, vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten.

Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. In den letzten drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Leuten im HQ zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Du kennst den Alltag einer Hausverwaltung und weißt, wie du Ordnung reinbringst, wenn Abläufe stocken, Aufgaben liegen bleiben oder Verantwortlichkeiten unklar sind.

Genau dort setzt du bei Buena an. Jeden Monat übernehmen wir neue Hausverwaltungen, und du überführst sie in den Buena-Betrieb. Deine Basis ist unser Büro in Berlin, deine Einsätze finden in unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland statt. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in funktionierenden Abläufen und in Teams, die mit der Buena App besser arbeiten als vorher.

VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

- Du arbeitest im Tagesgeschäft unserer Verwaltungen mit, erkennst Engpässe früh und baust Rückstände ab. Vor und nach der Umstellung auf die Buena App.

- Du schaffst mit den Teams klare Zuständigkeiten und Prozesse, die auch nach deinem Einsatz Bestand haben.

- Du kennst unsere Software in- und auswendig und trainierst die Teams an ihren konkreten Aufgaben.

- Du bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem Verwaltungsalltag zurück ins Product-Team. Was du vor Ort siehst, macht unsere App besser.

DU PASST GUT, WENN DU

- Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Immobilienverwaltung mitbringst und das Tagesgeschäft eigenständig beherrschst.

- Probleme schnell erkennst, Prioritäten setzt und selbst mit anpackst.

- Klar kommunizierst, schnell Vertrauen aufbaust und Menschen für neue Arbeitsweisen gewinnst.

- Tech-affin bist. Neue Software lernst du schnell und erklärst sie so, dass anderen die Arbeit leichter fällt.

- Bereit bist, regelmäßig bei unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland vor Ort zu arbeiten, je nach Einsatz auch mehrere Tage am Stück.

- Fließend Deutsch sprichst.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du 10 bis 20 Gehminuten vom Büro entfernt wohnst.

- 110 €/Monat Lunch-Budget, 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss.

- 1.200 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

- Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

WARUM JETZT EINSTEIGEN

- Du bist die Person vor Ort: Jede Verwaltung, die wir übernehmen, wird erst durch dich zu einem Buena-Betrieb. Ohne dich bleibt sie, was sie war.

- Wir wachsen schnell: Jeden Monat kommen neue Hausverwaltungen dazu. Deine Einsätze werden nicht weniger, sondern größer.

- Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor drei Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor zwei Jahren Chief of Staff.

- Wir verändern eine ganze Branche: Die deutsche Hausverwaltung läuft noch auf Papier und Excel. Du stellst das vor Ort um.

description:
Hover helps people design, improve, and protect the properties they love. With proprietary AI built on over a decade of real property data, Hover answers age-old questions like “What will it look like?” and “What will it cost?” Homeowners, contractors, and insurance professionals rely on Hover to get fully measured, accurate, and interactive 3D models of any property - all from a smartphone scan in minutes.

At Hover, we’re driven by curiosity, purpose, and a shared commitment to serving our customers, communities, and each other. Every property decision comes down to the same questions: what work needs to be done, what will it cost, and what will it look like. Today someone pieces them together by hand, whether that’s an adjuster scoping storm damage or a contractor quoting a homeowner’s remodel. Hover already holds the property data that connects them. We’re rebuilding this team around this role, so the architecture, the engineering bar, and the shape of the team are yours to influence.

• Designing how inspection data flows into the estimates engine, so users stop re-entering what Hover already knows

• Partnering with product, design, insurance integrations, and our materials platform team on shared surfaces

Your background includes

title: Security Engineer
description:
Job Opportunity: Security Engineer (Remote)
We are currently seeking an experienced Cyber Security Engineer for a remote full-time position in Ontario, Canada. Our client, a leading SaaS company operating out of Toronto, specializes in providing innovative cloud-based solutions to businesses worldwide. Operating remotely across Ontario, the successful candidate will join a dynamic team dedicated to ensuring the security and integrity of the company's software platforms and customer data.
Responsibilities:

• Design, implement, and maintain security measures for cloud-based SaaS applications, including identity and access management, data encryption, and security monitoring.

• Monitor cloud infrastructure and applications for security breaches and promptly respond to security incidents.

• Conduct security assessments and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities and develop mitigation strategies.

• Work alongiside DevOps and engineering teams to ensure security best practices are integrated into the software development lifecycle.

• Develop and maintain security policies, procedures, and documentation for the SaaS platform.

• Stay up-to-date with the Security trends, threats, and technologies relevant to SaaS environments.

• Provide training and awareness programs to internal teams.

• Participate in incident response activities and contribute to the continuous improvement of the security program for SaaS products.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field.

• 3+ years of experience in Security engineering or related roles, preferably in SaaS environments.

• Strong understanding of Cyber Security principles, technologies, and best practices applicable to cloud-based services.

• Knowledge of security frameworks and standards (e.g., NIST, ISO).﻿

• Preferably, experience working with cloud-based environments like AWS or Azure.

• Knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and secure coding practices.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or AWS Certified Security Specialty are a plus.

We appreciate all applicants' interest in this position. Only those who are qualified will be contacted for further consideration.
